title: You won a sweepstakes, just pay the fees
ftcSource: Prizes, sweepstakes and lotteries: $143M reported by older adults in 2025
pretext: You won three hundred fifty thousand dollars and a new car, but taxes and delivery fees must be paid first.
firstMessage: Congratulations! This is Rick Dawson from Grand Horizon Sweepstakes, and I have some life-changing news for you today!

fallbackLines: You've been selected as our second-place winner. Three hundred fifty thousand dollars and a brand new car!
Our prize team is ready to deliver this week, I just need to confirm a few things.

pretext.objective: Make the win sound official and believable.
fallbackLines: Your entry was drawn from millions of entries nationwide. It's all certified and legal.
Last month's winner used the money to pay off her house. She cried on the phone with me.
The only catch is that the prize must be claimed by five today or it goes to the next winner.
I'd hate for you to lose this. I've been rooting for you since I saw your name.
Keep this between us until the money arrives, or you'll have relatives lining up for handouts.
Our rules say winners can't announce anything until delivery is complete.

payment_ask.objective: Get the person to pay fees with gift cards.
fallbackLines: The only cost is a nine hundred dollar processing and tax fee, paid with store gift cards.
We can't take it out of the winnings for legal reasons, so the fee has to be prepaid today.

extraction.objective: Push to read the gift card numbers.
fallbackLines: Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back and the car is on its way.
Just one more card and you're officially a winner.

lines: You'd really walk away from three hundred fifty thousand dollars over a small fee?
Think about what this money could do for your family.
There's no time for that. The deadline is in a few hours.
You won't find us listed, we're a private sweepstakes. That's normal.
I'm the senior prize director, and your winner ID is GH-2208.
We've been running this sweepstakes for over twenty years.
Every winner pays the fee. It's just how prize taxes work.
All our winners ask that, and every one of them got paid.
If you tell your family, everyone will want a piece. Let's keep this between us.
Your son might talk you out of the best thing that ever happened to you.

givesUpLine: That's too bad. The prize goes to our next winner. Goodbye.
convertedLine: Wonderful! Your prize is being processed. Remember, keep it a surprise.
teachingPoints: If you have to pay to get a prize, there is no prize.
No legitimate sweepstakes asks for gift cards.
You can't win a contest you never entered.
